method: Androguard 4.1.4 static manifest parsing + Android Build Tools 35.0.0 apksigner signature verification. APKs were not installed or executed.
limitations: Five samples demonstrate integration behavior, not detection accuracy.
Valid signatures establish identity, not publisher legitimacy or safety.
Declared permissions are capabilities; grants, actual behavior, remote code, DEX behavior and signing lineage are not assessed.
Two risky cases are purpose-built training apps, not real-world malicious APKs.
APK binaries and embedded personal strings are excluded from this publication.
